# `prefer-optional-capture`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports an optional checked for non-null and then force-unwrapped in the guarded
branch.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

An optional capture expresses and names the proven payload without repeating
`.?` operations.

## When it fires

It applies when all relevant unwraps can be replaced with a collision-free
capture without changing mutation semantics.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn f(maybe: ?u32) u32 {
    if (maybe != null) {
        return maybe.?;
    }
    return 0;
}
```

Reference: <https://ziglang.org/documentation/master/#if-with-Optionals>
